description: Filter articles by gpt-5-6-luna sentiment labels (accent/case-insensitive exact match). One model's reading, not a consensus — 4 other models scored the same articles and often disagree; get_sentiment_distribution with model:"all" shows by how much. `subjectivity` is much the weakest of the three scales, so treat a set selected on it as a lead to read rather than as a finding.

centrality.description: Très central | Central | Secondaire | Marginal | Non abordé

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Togo (accents optional)

disputed.description: polarite | centralite | subjectivite — keep only articles the panel SPLIT on for that field (French field names, as stored). Selects contested readings, not a sentiment value.

polarity.description: Très positif | Positif | Neutre | Négatif | Très négatif | Non applicable

subjectivity.description: Très objectif | Plutôt objectif | Mixte | Plutôt subjectif | Très subjectif — least to most subjective. Unscored where the model answered Non abordé, so this filter also excludes those.

name: search_by_sentiment
title: Filter articles by AI sentiment
